items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: But then we became such friends that he had me on his dates and vice versa

ctx.x: Dick Hyman and I became friends and he — well that’s how I did my very first recording under my own name. He took me on a date to play behind a singer. I don’t even think I had anything written down. He said well just play it, and then play a solo for eight bars here or something. That was Esoteric Records. They were too. So we did the date and they asked me to do a date under my own name, and that was a ten inch LP in the early ‘50s. But then we became such friends that he had me on his dates and vice versa, and…
Yeah, he’s been involved in some very interesting projects.
